text:
elena (Finance): :mega: Update on hosted billing rules that goes live in two weeks. Summary: free credits for new signups will be reduced from $200 to $75, we'll introduce soft hosted rate limits (with a 7-day grace for overages), and invoices will show a 48h overage preview link to help customers avoid surprises. Full rollout doc: https://redwood.internal/billing/new-hosted-policy

mike (Eng): Clarifying Qs: do Dedicated/reserved customers see any of these soft limits?

elena (Finance): No impact to Dedicated customers under contract. These soft limits apply to hosted pay-as-you-go API keys only. Dedicated customers keep current SLAs and billing.

ajay (Platform): How are soft limits enforced? per-key or per-account? What about bursty RAG patterns?

elena (Finance): Soft limits are per-API-key with an account-level cap. Enforcement is sliding-window token tracking. We provide a "burst" allowance for SDK keys and a form to request extra burst for RAG-type workloads.

billing-bot: NOTICE: `/billing preview <acct>` available to all staff. Preview emails will be sent to accounts projected to exceed $100 in overages during preview window.

chris (Customer Success): CS playbook + email templates are in the rollout doc. We'll start direct outreach two weeks before enforcement.

sara (Eng-ML): Any special handling for embeddings? Our customers send many small embedding calls.

elena (Finance): Embeddings count as tokens; encourage batching + caching. We'll auto-run Redwood Optimize suggestions for top 100 at-risk accounts.

mike (Eng): Console change: we'll add an "expected overage" banner and a preview card customers can pin.

elena (Finance): Timeline: preview mode (informational) 16 now; opt-in beta next week; enforcement with automated throttling + billing at unix ts 1762776000. Reminder: 7-day grace period before charging to give customers time to react.

elena (Finance): Also: invoices will include a separate line for projected overages and link to the preview so customers see potential charges before they finalize.

chris (Customer Success): Looping in Legal & Partnerships for notification cadence.

billing-bot: REMINDER: nightly preview export will email account owners for 10 days.
thread_summary: Finance announces hosted billing changes: lower new signup credits, soft hosted rate limits with 7-day grace, invoice preview tool; Dedicated unaffected; rollout timeline and customer-notification plan.
